svg.aria-label: How the rate adapts, frame by frame
svg.title: How the rate adapts, frame by frame
svg.text: How the rate adapts, frame by frame
The busy stretch of the video, with a rule like Swappy's. It keeps the frames of the last 2 s: when more than 10 % of them
missed, it drops to half rate; when none missed and their average render time plus 1 ms fits a refresh with 1 ms to spare,
it goes back up. After each change it starts a new 2 s window, and decides nothing until that holds 2 s of frames.
Blue: the window a decision was made on. Dashed: a new window filling, its values dashed while the rule does not use them yet.
none missed, 15.6 ms fits: full rate
